scope: Controlled B0 development only. Not B2, not a causal shock model, no automatic promotion.
prior_work: Do not repeat quadratic curvature or group-weight search. Reuse qualified observed-driver archive; isolate nonlinear effect with an identical-input control.

basis.type: two shared one-knot linear regression splines
basis.meaning: Below versus above own historical-normal pooled annual departure; not GDP percentage zero and not a country/event dummy
basis.calibration: 2016–2020 training-country-only, label-free, country-balanced; no intercept so H(0)=0
basis.support: At least3 training countries, each with3 supported intervals, two-sided variation; otherwise disable term
basis.tails: Clamp only added term at training input envelope; retain base term; record extrapolation

information.legacy: Canonical B0 historical pooled signals and damped continuation
information.observed: Existing WDI population, urban population, real GDP per capita, real GFCF; only existing annual axes updated after2020
information.lag: Unchanged archived observed-driver distributed lag and causal post2020 smoothing
information.missing: Qualified-source masks and explicit shared continuation, never missing-source zero
information.future: Last available annual axis damped0.8; WUP horizontal path retained. No future crisis knowledge
information.conflict: No refreshed post2020 conflict/damage input. War response cannot be inferred from missing observations
information.vintage: Latest-vintage reported/estimated indicators; not origin-valid forecast inputs

fixed: original source quality and fixed family weights

scoring.main: Five-country native Total common2020anchor stock-increment error; country macro
scoring.fiveyear_countries: Four; no manufactured Finnish windows across publisher break
scoring.other: Original RES and Total ratio channels scored separately, before and after sector allocation
scoring.breaks: Reuse FIN2019–20 and KOR2015–16 publisher breaks
scoring.shock_window: 2020–2022 endpoints: descriptive exposure, not causal identification
scoring.deterioration: Annual country MAE rise>0.1pp flags harm; experimental flag, not a new Spec rule
scoring.comparison: Within identical-input pairs primary; input update contrasts separate; no selecting one model per country

freeze: Complete and hash all model/prediction files before computing candidate national scores

literature.title: Forecasting: Principles and Practice / nonlinear regression
mgcv / basis dimension and penalized degrees of freedom

pre_fit_repair.stage: before any national fit or scoring
pre_fit_repair.reason: Synthetic intervention changed raw input but left its qualification mask false; the correct implementation ignored the unqualified value. Correct the test fixture to admit the synthetic observed value.
